_comment: Items in the Recognized Reviewer program are free to claim, so min_value_usd filters on RETAIL value - 'only wake me for the good stuff'. Real listings run roughly $5-$30, so keep the thresholds low: a $100 floor is silence forever. Rules are evaluated top-down; the first match wins and sets the notification priority.

_unused_examples._note: Move any of these into rules above to use them.

everything.name: everything
everything._why: No clauses = matches every item. Useful for a day or two to see what actually drops before you tune the real rules.
